title: Model source verification (v1)
description: The `verification` object every local-engine / allternit-api response that hands out model bytes carries. Rust: services/model-source `Verification`. TS: contracts/model-source/types.ts.

source_url.description: Base URL of the source that served the bytes, before redirects. File URL = source_url + percent-encoded path. Never carries a signed query string.

manifest_commit.description: Upstream commit of the signed Freeweights manifest. Present only when a manifest was used (state freeweights_signed).

checked_at.description: UTC time the hash was checked.

state.description: freeweights_signed: sha256 from a minisign-verified Freeweights manifest. publisher_hash: sha256 from the publisher (Hugging Face lfs.oid), catalog not used. pinned: sha256 the caller supplied. unverified: no hash, caller explicitly allowed it.
